keyFeatures: 28-question assessment focused on workplace and interpersonal behavioral styles
Scores across four dimensions: Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness
Identifies your primary and secondary behavioral style for team and communication insights
Practical guidance on how your DISC profile affects collaboration, leadership, and conflict resolution
tips: Answer based on how you actually behave at work, not how you wish you behaved — DISC is most useful when it reflects your real patterns.
Use your DISC profile to understand colleagues better: knowing others' styles helps you adapt your communication for less friction.
